Free abstract upward movement models acceptance below an entry upper bound. Each coordinate cut requires max(balance,0) paid downward crossings. Balanced weak connectivity supplies an Euler circuit and hence an order.

mathematicalAndScopeReviews.bounds: N2..1000000;l,c1..1e9;d0..1e9;distinct main endpoints, adjacent allowed;one optional leaf per main station
mathematicalAndScopeReviews.principalProof: For sorted station and shortcut endpoints, uncrossing makes the forward shortcut orientation no longer than reverse. Only pairs whose original distance exceeds K impose the four sum/difference bounds, each including c. The sum of the two largest distinct branch lengths is a necessary lower bound; under it, a_i<b_j-K excludes i>j, and keeping two extrema excludes i=j. The two sort orders are independent of K. For candidate y, the lower bound max(Slo-y,y+Dlo) is V-shaped; clipping the second index to >first retains two monotone phases, so the discrete endpoint scan is O(N).

mathematicalAndScopeReviews.bounds: Power-of-two N, scored8/32/128;all stated write/read budgets;strict full128/896/896;all writes then exactly one compile then reads;fixed p
mathematicalAndScopeReviews.principalProof: At a partition block of size m, signatures have outside bits1 and one left-half marker. Different depths have different Hamming weights; equal-depth blocks have nonempty zero supports in disjoint position sets. Hence membership is not contaminated by another block. After compile the current output-position set identifies the original interval; one marker distinguishes its half, and a leaf writes answer[outputPosition]=originalIndex. Calls are exactly (N/2)log2N writes and Nlog2N reads:80/160 at32 and448/896 at128, including both asymmetric budgets. Character operations are O(N²logN), distinct from oracle-call count.

mathematicalAndScopeReviews.bounds: N1..100000;M1..1000000;1<=K<=N;r,c0..M-1;duplicates allowed;at mostK diagonal cell-aligned squares;union cells counted once
mathematicalAndScopeReviews.principalProof: Transform each cell to [min(r,c),max(r,c)] and remove contained requirements. Remaining L/R increase strictly. Photos can cover contiguous requirement groups and be shrunk to group extremes; new union area subtracts exactly the previous boundary overlap square. The expanded edge weight is Monge. For q-1 and q+1 partition paths, a common rank-difference-one cut or the first Q-minus-P cut imbalance2 provides an explicit nonincreasing-cost suffix exchange into two q-edge paths, proving discrete convexity. Integer marginal savings and fewer-photo ties then justify G(lambda)-lambda*K at the first <=K count. Strictly ordered slopes/queries give linear monotone CHT per penalty, plus one sort.
mathematicalAndScopeReviews.provenance: Official union correction/CHT/penalty solution; independent constructive convexity and integer tie-boundary proof. Small-subtask Knuth is not claimed verified.
